name: zotero-research-bridge
description: Manage and classify local Zotero papers, build required problem–method maps, and optionally generate deep HTML reading reports through conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Organize and analyze Zotero papers by conversation
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a local Zotero library to import and deduplicate papers, organize them into research collections, analyze the actual PDF, build required external machine-readable problem–method maps for later matching and innovation analysis, and optionally generate a portable HTML reading report linked back to its Zotero parent item.
defaultPrompt: 整理我的 Zotero 文献并给出分类建议。
分析这篇 Zotero 论文并生成问题—方法 map；不要生成阅读报告。
分析这篇 Zotero 论文，生成 map 和学术深度 HTML 阅读报告。
分析这个 Zotero 集合，并为每篇论文建立问题—方法匹配档案。
把这篇 PDF 去重后加入 Zotero，并完成分类。
